test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

His artwork is / more intricate / than any artist / in the gallery.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. than any artist .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment "**than any artist**" is grammatically incorrect because the sentence compares the artwork to artists, which is illogical.
 
• The comparison should be between similar entities. The correct comparison should be "**than that of any artist**," referring to the artwork of the other artists.
 
• In English grammar, when comparing something belonging to a person or group, the possessive form or "that of" should be used to make the comparison clear and logical.

Correct sentence: *His artwork is more intricate than that of any artist in the gallery*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparison Rules:**
 
 
• When comparing two things, ensure that the entities being compared are of the same type (e.g., object to object, person to person).
 
• If the sentence involves possession, use "that of" or "those of" to clarify the comparison.
 
• Example: Her performance was better than **that of** her classmates.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Incorrect: This car is faster than any other driver.
 
• Correct: This car is faster than any other car.
